info.name: Mail OIDC Bridge
info.summary: Bridges user_oidc tokens with Mail app for XOAUTH2 authentication
info.description:
Allows the Nextcloud Mail app to use OIDC tokens from user_oidc for XOAUTH2 authentication with mail servers.
This app listens to BeforeImapClientCreated events and injects the OIDC access token into mail accounts configured with xoauth2 authentication method.
Requirements: - user_oidc app with store_login_token enabled - Mail app with accounts configured for xoauth2 - Mail server supporting OAuth2 authentication
info.author: Sergio Serra
